ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: in the attached figure, there is a purple-filled right-angled broken-line shape, an S-like polygon. The figure marks the top horizontal side as 10 and the bottom horizontal side as 10; if divided by horizontal layers, it can be seen that there are three horizontal bands in total, and the vertical height of each band is marked as 5. The middle part has a horizontal segment marked as 7, and the offset part of the figure corresponds to the remaining length 10 - 7 = 3. Then reason: according to the specified method, divide the figure into three non-overlapping horizontal rectangular strips. The height of each horizontal strip is 5. The horizontal length of the top strip is 10, and its area is 10 × 5 = 50; the total horizontal length of the middle strip is also 10, because it is composed of the marked 7 plus the offset overlapping part 3, and its area is 10 × 5 = 50; the horizontal length of the bottom strip is 10, and its area is 10 × 5 = 50. Total area = 50 + 50 + 50 = 150.

method.method_draft: Read the figure as a rectilinear S-shaped polygon divided into three horizontal strips. From the image, each strip has vertical height 5. The top strip has horizontal length 10, the bottom strip has horizontal length 10, and the middle strip also has total horizontal length 10 because it consists of the labeled exposed length 7 plus the overlapping/offset part of length 10 - 7 = 3. Compute the area as the sum of three non-overlapping rectangles: 10×5 + 10×5 + 10×5 = 150.
